title: Control Nodes, Managed Nodes, and Installation
objective: Distinguish Ansible components and verify an installation.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Ansible runs on one Unix-like control node and normally reaches managed nodes over SSH. Managed nodes need a connection account and Python for most modules, but not an Ansible agent.
Version checks establish which executable, Python runtime, configuration file, and module paths are active before troubleshooting connectivity.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Distinguish Ansible components and verify an installation.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:
verification:
  command: ansible --version
  expect: ansible_core
  managed_node_agent: false
examples.note: Use this as a reasoning model before applying changes to the disposable lab.
